name: Shining Medal
text: Before bidding, reveal a chosen card in your hand; your revealed cards gain +4 rank.
prototypeNote: Before bidding, use Reveal card on the chosen card, then Edit card to give each of your revealed cards +4 rank.

signature.target: a chosen card; your revealed cards
signature.frequency: once per round; all revealed cards

archetypes: Bonus Chaser; splash Kingmaker, Contract Attacker
decision: Which card to reveal and raise: a queen becomes a sure winner, while a middle card becomes a threat the whole table can plan around.
opponent: Fully visible: the table sees the revealed card and its rank before bidding.
aiNote: Reveal your highest non-ace card in your longest non-spade suit; count each revealed card at its raised rank when bidding.
rationale: It enables itself: one chosen card gains +4 every round, and Chasing Rainbows' reveal (DU-S05) gains it too. Choosing the card is stronger than Honed Edge's random +3, and showing it to the table is the price, which places it at uncommon.
deviation: Moved from common to uncommon (RE-U12 to RE-U12) and given its own reveal, because the common version depended on reveals from other sigils.
